tier1.headline: Your Data Is Sold
tier1.quote: When we engage in those activities, we sell personal information (i.e., information from cookies) to third-party advertisers and analytics companies.

tier1.headline: Your Data Trains AI
tier1.quote: If you connect your Linktree account to a third-party social platform—such as Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube—we collect and process information from those accounts... We use this information to help you manage your social presence through Linktree Services, provide AI-powered insights and personalize your experience, and for other purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

tier1.headline: Your Content Is Scanned
tier1.quote: We may undertake automatic scanning of your content—including User Profiles, links, communications (such as messages), and searches you perform—to support compliance with our Terms of Service and/or Community Standards.

tier1.headline: Your Data Is Collected
tier1.quote: This Privacy Notice only applies to personal information we collect as a controller about: individuals who visit, sign up to use, or interact with the Linktree Services or User Profiles, whether directly or through third party applications that connect with Linktree.

tier2.headline: Your DNT Requests Ignored
tier2.quote: We use cookies and other tracking technologies to display advertisements to you on Linktree and on non-affiliated websites, applications, and online services.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Broadly
tier2.quote: We may disclose your personal information to the following categories of recipients: to our group companies and third party services providers (for example, to support the delivery of the Linktree Services, provide functionality, facilitate payments, fulfill tax obligations, or enhance the security of the Linktree Services).

tier2.headline: Your Data Retained Indefinitely
tier2.quote: We will retain your personal information for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Notice and in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements in respect of permitted or required retention periods and limitation periods relevant to legal action.

tier2.headline: Your Precise Location Collected
tier2.quote: Usage and Analytics Data: We collect information like your IP address, device type, unique device identification numbers, browser-type, broad geographic location (e.g. country or city-level location), time zone, usage data, diagnostic data and other technical information.

tier2.headline: Your Profile Is Created
tier2.quote: To personalize and improve your experience of using the Linktree Services, including To ensure the Linktree Services are relevant to you, by analysing your activity on the Platform to understand your interests and preferences, and deliver personalised, targeted and/or localised content based on your activity data, location and preferences.

tier2.headline: Your Ads Are Targeted
tier2.quote: To display advertising across Linktree and non-affiliated websites, applications, and online services, and to personalize and measure the effectiveness of those advertisements.

tier2.headline: Your Data Goes Overseas
tier2.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than the country in which you are a resident.

tier2.headline: Your Data Given To Law Enforcement
tier2.quote: To respond to requests from law enforcement, courts, or other competent authorities.
